criterios_aceite.cmd: b="$(git merge-base HEAD origin/staging-auto)"; r=NAO_AFROUXOU; for f in test/cron-paths-vercel.test.ts; do [ -f "$f" ] || { git cat-file -e "$b:$f" 2>/dev/null && r=APAGOU_$f; continue; }; for p in 'expect(' 'it('; do a=$(git show "$b:$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -cF "$p"); n=$(grep -cF "$p" "$f"); [ "${n:-0}" -ge "${a:-0}" ] || r=CAIU_$f; done; s0=$(git show "$b:$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -cE '\.(skip|only|todo)\('); s1=$(grep -cE '\.(skip|only|todo)\(' "$f"); [ "${s1:-0}" -le "${s0:-0}" ] || r=SKIP_NOVO_$f; d0=$(git show "$b:$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'toBeDefined()'); d1=$(grep -c 'toBeDefined()' "$f"); [ "${d1:-0}" -le "${d0:-0}" ] || r=TOBEDEFINED_NOVO_$f; done; echo $r
